data.name: Agha
data.gender_notes: Agha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A man of high status and respect, an elder, a leader, and a guide. In Urdu, Agha is also used as a title for a respected elder or a religious leader. The name Agha carries the meaning “Leader, elder, respected one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Agha usually hope their child will grow to embody leader, elder, respected one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of wisdom, guidance, and respect in the community. A beacon of light for the lost and a leader for the followers.
data.etymology: Agha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Leader, elder, respected one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Agha total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: آغا
in_arabic.meaning: الآغا هو سيد أو قائد أو نبيل
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم الآغا مشتق من الجذر العربي أ غ ا والذي يعني السيد أو القائد أو النبيل. وقد استخدم هذا اللفظ في التاريخ الإسلامي للإشارة إلى القادة أو الأمراء في بعض الدول الإسلامية، وخاصة في الدولة العثمانية. ويرتبط الآغا بالمعاني الرفيعة والمناصب العالية، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل قيمة تاريخية واجتماعية كبيرة في الثقافة العربية والإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: آغا
in_urdu.meaning: آغا کا مطلب ہے مالک، سربراہ یا رئیس
in_urdu.long_meaning: آغا نام کی اصطلاح عربی زبان سے نکلی ہے، جس میں آغا کو مالک، سربراہ یا رئیس کے طور پر بیان کیا گیا ہے۔ اس نام کا تعلق تاریخی طور پر اناطولیہ اور مشرق وسطی کے علاقوں سے ہے، جہاں یہ اعزازی لقب کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا تھا۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، آغا نام احترام، اقتدار اور قیادت کی عکاسی کرتا ہے، اور اکثر ممتاز افراد یا عظیم خاندانوں کے افراد کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आगा
in_hindi.meaning: आगा का अर्थ है मालिक या सरदार
in_hindi.long_meaning: आगा नाम की उत्पत्ति तुर्की और अरबी भाषाओं से हुई है, जहां यह नाम उच्च पदस्थ अधिकारियों या अभिजात वर्ग के लिए उपयोग किया जाता था। इस्लामी परंपरा में, आगा नाम नेतृत्व, शक्ति और सम्मान की भावना को दर्शाता है। यह नाम अक्सर प्रभावशाली व्यक्तियों या प्रमुख परिवारों के सदस्यों को दिया जाता है, जो उनकी स्थिति और प्रभुत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: آغا
in_pashto.meaning: آغا دے مطلب دے مالک یا خان
in_pashto.long_meaning: په پښتو کې، آغا د سترګو، بادشاه، یا خان په معنا کارول کېږي. دا نوم د تاريخي پلوه د پښتنو او نورو اسلامي ټولنو لپاره د يو احترامي لقب په توګه کارولل شوی دی. آغا نوم د يو شخص د لوړ مقام، قدرت، او اغيزې څرګندوي، او ډیری وختونه د مشرانو يا واکمنو کسانو لپاره کارولل کیږي.

in_english.name: Agha
in_english.meaning: Agha means a lord, master, or leader in Arabic and Turkish cultures
in_english.long_meaning: The name Agha originates from the Arabic root 'a-gh-a' (أ غ ا), which conveys meanings related to leadership, mastery, and nobility. Historically, Agha was used as a title of respect for high-ranking officials, military officers, and noble individuals in various Islamic cultures, including the Ottoman Empire. The name symbolizes authority, power, and prestige, and is often associated with individuals of significant social or political influence. In contemporary usage, Agha remains a respected and meaningful name across many Muslim communities worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Agha" reflects the deeply rooted culture of respecting elders and esteemed figures in the Muslim community. In many Muslim families, the eldest male relative holds the title of "Agha" and is often seen as a source of wisdom, guidance, and support. This tradition is deeply ingrained in Muslim society and dates back to ancient times when elders were considered the keepers of knowledge and wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Agha" also carries significant spiritual meaning, as it is often associated with spiritual guidance and moral leadership. In many Sufi traditions, the spiritual guide or sheikh is referred to as "Agha," reflecting the reverence and deep respect that followers hold for their teachers. Similarly, in everyday Muslim life, the elder family member or community leader may be looked upon for spiritual guidance and support, making the title "Agha" a symbol of wisdom, knowledge, and spiritual guidance.
